e.title: VineCopula (R)
e.summary: Vine copula 统计推断（CRAN 2.6.1，行业标准）：C/D/R-vine 结构选择、参数估计、拟合检验
e.summary_en: Vine copula statistical inference (CRAN 2.6.1, industry standard): C/D/R-vine structure selection, parameter estimation, goodness-of-fit
e.summary_hk: Vine copula 統計推斷（CRAN 2.6.1，行業標準）：C/D/R-vine 結構選擇、參數估計、擬合檢驗
e.body: VineCopula（CRAN 2.6.1）是 Vine copula 的统计推断标准包：C-vine/D-vine/R-vine 结构选择、pair-copula 参数估计、拟合优度检验、模拟——高维依赖建模的行业标准。对 RIAA：Vine copula 的权威实现——[[insurance-copula]]（burning-cost Vine 定价）的 R 对照；高维依赖（多风险线/多地区）建模（[[insurance-synthetic]] vine 合成数据配套）；与 [[copula-r]]（基础 copula）、rvinecopulib（高性能底层）配套；保险组合风险的依赖结构推断；适合高维依赖建模方向。
e.body_en: VineCopula (CRAN 2.6.1) is the standard package for vine copula statistical inference: C-vine/D-vine/R-vine structure selection, pair-copula parameter estimation, goodness-of-fit tests, simulation — the industry standard for high-dimensional dependence modelling. For RIAA: the authoritative implementation of vine copulas — the R counterpart of [[insurance-copula]] (burning-cost vine pricing); high-dimensional dependence (multi-line/multi-region) modelling (pairs with [[insurance-synthetic]] vine synthetic data); with [[copula-r]] (base copulas) and rvinecopulib (high-performance backend); dependence structure inference for insurance portfolio risk; suits high-dimensional dependence modelling.
e.body_hk: VineCopula（CRAN 2.6.1）是 Vine copula 的統計推斷標準包：C-vine/D-vine/R-vine 結構選擇、pair-copula 參數估計、擬合優度檢驗、模擬——高維依賴建模的行業標準。對 RIAA：Vine copula 的權威實現——[[insurance-copula]]（burning-cost Vine 定價）的 R 對照；高維依賴（多風險線/多地區）建模（[[insurance-synthetic]] vine 合成數據配套）；與 [[copula-r]]（基礎 copula）、rvinecopulib（高性能底層）配套；保險組合風險的依賴結構推斷；適合高維依賴建模方向。
